description: Are these timing constraints satisfiable? Earliest/latest time per event, or the conflicting constraints — Solves a simple temporal network: up to 40 named time points, up to 200 difference constraints 'b is between min and max minutes after a' and optional fixed instants, relative to a caller origin instant.
